author: Spoookeh
body:
Hey there,

I was recently in-games trying to organise a scrim when Rememes (Remeh) started saying rude things directed towards myself. This hasn't only happened once but on numerous occasions. I was offended and I hope an appropriate punishment is issued.

Evidence (Imgur Album): http://imgur.com/a/t14Fc

Thanks for reading.
